headline: Cemex Achieves Double-Digit Growth in Q3 Transformation Progress
summary: Cemex reported its fifth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth driven by ongoing corporate transformation initiatives.
why: Cemex is a global building materials company providing cement, ready-mix concrete, and aggregates, serving as a bellwether for construction activity.

impacts.name: Cemex
impacts.why: Sustained revenue and earnings growth validate the success of operational transformation and pricing strategies.
